real_defects.issue: normalizeJob stripped every comma before Number(), so a CSV cell "4,50" (European $4.50) priced the garments at $450 with no error (repro: normalizeJob({garmentCost:'4,50'}).job.garmentCost === 450). Fixed: parseAmount accepts a comma only as a thousands separator and errors otherwise; money_comma_baseline.txt line removed.

Number() accepted hex/binary/exponent spellings, so quantity '0x18' quoted 24 pieces and '1e1' 10 (repro: normalizeJob({quantity:'0x18'}).job.quantity === 24). Fixed by the same strict decimal pattern.

The CLI flag check used bare Number(v), so '--garment-cost $4.50' and '--margin 40%' were refused with 'needs a number' though the same text in a CSV cell was accepted. Fixed: the CLI uses the engine's parseAmount.
